speakers.name: Mukund Jha
speakers.bio: Co-founded Dunzo, then Emergent with his twin brother Madhav. Emergent became a $1.5B unicorn in July 2026, serving 200,000+ paying customers. Together wrote its first cheque.

speakers.name: Tanay Kothari
speakers.bio: Started Wispr in 2021 with Sahaj Garg to make voice the main way we use computers. Wispr Flow is used by millions and raised a $280M Series B at a $2B valuation.

speakers.name: Marc Manara
speakers.bio: Leads OpenAI's global Startups, VC and Private Equity teams. Previously ran the startups team at AWS and co-founded Farm Hill. Harvard CS, Stanford MBA.

speakers.name: Srinivas Narayanan
speakers.bio: Joined OpenAI in 2023 as VP of Engineering through ChatGPT's fastest growth, then became CTO of B2B Applications. Before that, a decade-plus as VP of Engineering at Facebook. IIT Madras.

speakers.name: Gaurav Agarwal
speakers.bio: Joined ClickUp as Chief Growth Officer and became COO, leading revenue operations and scaling it past $300M ARR with product-led and sales-led growth side by side.

speakers.name: Yash Sheth
speakers.bio: Co-founded Galileo, the evaluation and observability platform for AI agents, which Cisco announced it would acquire in 2026. Spent nearly a decade at Google leading speech platforms.

speakers.name: Soham Ganatra
speakers.bio: Building Composio, the skill layer that lets AI agents connect to and act across thousands of tools. Raised a $25M Series A to build it from Bengaluru and San Francisco.

speakers.name: Neha Singh
speakers.bio: Built Tracxn into a listed private-markets intelligence company. Formerly at Sequoia Capital and BCG. IIT Bombay and Stanford MBA.
